'''Coruscant''' was the nickname given to a tall, blond-haired [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] on [[Selvaris]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]. The nickname referred to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], as many of the prisoners were referred to by such rather than their name. Coruscant had a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] deck, and brought it into the [[grashal]] that served as the prisoners' mess hall in order to provide a loud and boisterous cover for a secret message that [[Ryn one-one-five]], a member of the [[Ryn Network]], had smuggled into the compound.
